Guest Posting

What is guest posting — and why does it work?

A guest post is a helpful, well-researched article published on another website in your niche, with a natural link back to yours. Done right, it is one of the safest ways to build authority Google trusts.

Higher rankings

Quality backlinks are still one of Google’s strongest ranking signals.

More traffic

Your brand appears in front of an established, relevant audience.

Brand authority

Being featured on trusted sites builds credibility in your market.

Lasting results

Good placements stay live and keep passing value month after month.

FAQ

Questions clients ask first

Straight answers, before you spend anything.

How do we get started?

Send me your website and your target keywords on WhatsApp or email. I’ll do a free initial review, then share a clear plan — target pages, publisher options and honest pricing — before any work begins. Nothing starts without your approval.

What do you need from me?

Just three things: your website URL, the keywords or pages you want to rank, and your niche and budget range if you have one. From there I handle research, outreach, content coordination and reporting.

Are your backlinks safe for my site?

Yes. Everything is white-hat and manual — no link farms, no PBNs, no automated spam. Every publisher is checked by hand for real traffic and relevance, and links are placed naturally inside useful content, the way Google expects.

How long does SEO take to show results?

It depends on your market, your competition and your site’s starting point — anyone who guarantees a date is not being honest with you. What I do guarantee is the process: a prioritised plan, steady published work, and clear reports so you can see progress building month by month.

How will I track the work?

You receive the live URL of every placement, plus ranking and progress updates. You approve publisher options before publishing, so there are no surprises — you always know what was done and where your links are.

Can you place links on a specific site or niche?

Often, yes. I run outreach across a wide network — including a strong UK magazine network plus US and international publishers across business, tech, lifestyle, health, travel and more. Send me the site or niche you have in mind and I’ll check real availability and pricing.
